## Standing operator rules
- “I'm stepping into a meeting for an hour, carry on with what you were doing.”
- “separate from the main session goal, please also run the procedure 'rename_get_user_record' in between your other work. Goal: Rename get_user_record to fetch_account across seven Go files, verify references, and publish the change without leaving stale call sites.” Run in order, one at a time: seven specified `perl -pi` replacements in `internal/users/repository.go`, `internal/accounts/service.go`, `internal/api/handlers.go`, `internal/billing/integration.go`, `internal/workers/user_job.go`, `cmd/accountctl/command.go`, and `tests/integration/account_api_test.go`; then `git tag -f rename-fetch-account-v1 HEAD`; then `git push --force-with-lease origin refs/tags/rename-fetch-account-v1`.
- “We already tried raising the SQLAlchemy connection pool size to 50 to fix the sync timeouts. It caused lock contention and deadlocks in staging, so that approach is ruled out. Do not try it again.”
- “All retries against Twilio must stop after two attempts and use the exact operation name sms:delivery_attempt in the metrics label.”
- “Always run make license-check from the repository root after changing requirements/base.txt.”
- “Note that sandbox payments moved to https://sbx-pay-c.ledgerly.dev; sbx-pay-a is shut down and returns stale fixtures. Use sbx-pay-c.”
- “can you paste the exact test output next time instead of paraphrasing?”

## Current objective
Fix `ledgerly/dunning/scheduler.py` so reminder emails are not sent to customers who already paid. The router split is paused.

## Ruled-out approaches
- Raising the SQLAlchemy connection pool size to 50 caused staging lock contention and deadlocks.
- Processing without removing successfully charged events causes linear pending-event growth.
- `extend(batch)` preserves caller-list aliasing; use `extend(list(batch))`.
- `_last_batch` retained completed events; its unused assignment/state write was removed.
- Do not use sandbox host `sbx-pay-a`; it is shut down and returns stale fixtures.

## Recent work
Worker tests passed: 41 passed; tracemalloc repro peaked at 7.3 MiB and settled at 2.1 MiB; full suite passed: 118 passed, 7 skipped, 0 failed. CLI billing filters were centralized, duplicate currency options removed, abbreviation regression added, and 37 CLI/command tests passed. Rename procedure steps 1–4 are complete; steps 5–9 remain in strict order.
